 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The divider is the full-width uniform row; the most common other color is background.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg)
    line_color = g[divider][0]
    cells = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if r != divider and g[r][c] != bg]
    if not cells:
        return g
    minr = min(r for r, c, v in cells)
    maxr = max(r for r, c, v in cells)
    # Slide the figure up/down until it is immediately next to the divider, on its original side.
    if maxr < divider:
        dr = divider - 1 - maxr
    elif minr > divider:
        dr = divider + 1 - minr
    else:
        dr = 0
    for r, c, v in cells:
        g[r][c] = bg
    for r, c, v in cells:
        g[r + dr][c] = v
    g[divider] = [8] * w
    return g
